fixed.summary: A document's <joystick action>, <dpad action> and <button data-og-touch> drive their actions on a mouse or pad surface above 720p (a desktop window, a scripted og run or playtest at 1920x1080) and under a pinned og-ui unit: their input zones are where the controls are drawn, not their layout before the surface's scale, so a press on the drawn control (touch_move_to:Stick, touch_start) reaches its action.
